meta.name: shiny-bslib
meta.description: Build modern Shiny dashboards and applications using bslib (Bootstrap 5). Use when creating new Shiny apps, modernizing legacy apps (fluidPage, fluidRow/column, tabsetPanel, wellPanel, shinythemes), or working with bslib page layouts, grid systems, cards, value boxes, navigation, sidebars, filling layouts, theming, accordions, tooltips, popovers, toasts, or bslib inputs. Assumes familiarity with basic Shiny.

copy.tagline: 用 bslib 快速构建现代 Shiny 仪表盘和应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Shiny 开发或重构仪表盘界面。
